versionRationale: 1.2.0 (P4.6, Q1=a): domain-event now supports the explicitly discriminated kind=navigation Usage payload for revision/unit disclosures. Existing 187 corpus cases, expected outcomes, IRs and vectors are unchanged; dedicated navigation protocol tests add negative coverage for the new closed payload and tenant binding. 1.1.0 (P1.4 correction round 2, intentional contract changes, not a snapshot rewrite): Selection gains the required nullable trusted runRef binding (run-bound positive, missing/empty negatives, same-run/other-run/dropped-run binding vectors); every DomainEvent type has a closed payload projected from its normative record, so domain-event.valid drops sourceVersionId and adds appliesTo (payloadDigest and the domain.event-payload vector change accordingly) and unknown/documentText/credentials payload members are rejected; citation-ref.generated and citation-ref.ocr get their own documentRevisionId because they cite different IRs than the unicode revision (evidence-set.valid digest changes) and EvidenceSet rejects one revision with two irDigests; Result.error.code keeps approved codes in original case (POLICY_CHANGED, RETRYABLE_LOCK_TIMEOUT, POINTER_CONFLICT, HOLD_TOO_LATE) and the epoch-drift binding vector now expects POLICY_CHANGED; new Job record schema with all five states. 1.0.0: initial P1.4 corpus; every wire schema has valid and invalid cases; audit regressions R07-A01..R28-A02 and the mandatory Unicode/page/bbox/version/legacy-hash cases. Expected codes/paths and golden digests are authored intentionally; any change requires a new corpusVersion and rationale.
